easy: Made warm or hot.

ex.en: We swam in the heated pool even though it was snowing.
ex.ko: 눈이 오는데도 우리는 따뜻하게 데운 수영장에서 수영했다.

easy: Full of strong, angry feelings.

ex.en: My brother and I had a heated argument about the video game.
ex.ko: 동생과 나는 비디오 게임 때문에 격렬하게 말다툼을 했다.

easy: To put your arms around someone and hold them close.

ex.en: I hug my dog when I get home from school.
ex.ko: 나는 학교에서 돌아오면 우리 강아지를 꼭 안아 준다.

easy: To fit very close to your body.

ex.en: The new jeans hug my legs.
ex.ko: 새 청바지가 내 다리에 꼭 맞는다.

easy: When you put your arms around someone and hold them close.

ex.en: Grandma gave me a big hug at the airport.
ex.ko: 할머니는 공항에서 나를 꼭 안아 주셨다.

easy: In a way that matters a lot.

ex.en: Most importantly, wear your helmet when you ride a bike.
ex.ko: 무엇보다 중요한 것은, 자전거를 탈 때 헬멧을 써야 한다는 것이다.

easy: Inside a building, not outside.

ex.en: We play indoor games on rainy days.
ex.ko: 우리는 비 오는 날에 실내 게임을 한다.

easy: Happening or used inside a house or building.

ex.en: Our school has an indoor pool.
ex.ko: 우리 학교에는 실내 수영장이 있다.

easy: Having the power to change what people think or do.

ex.en: Her book was so influential that everyone in class read it.
ex.ko: 그 책은 영향력이 커서 반 친구들이 모두 읽었다.

easy: To plan to do something.

ex.en: I intend to read two books this weekend.
ex.ko: 나는 이번 주말에 책 두 권을 읽을 생각이다.

easy: Strong blue pants made of thick cloth.

ex.en: I wear jeans to school on Fridays.
ex.ko: 나는 금요일마다 청바지를 입고 학교에 간다.

easy: A small hole where water or air can get in or out.

ex.en: My bike tire has a leak, so it keeps going flat.
ex.ko: 내 자전거 바퀴에서 바람이 새서 자꾸 납작해진다.

easy: A small tool that makes a flame to start a fire.

ex.en: Dad used a lighter to start the campfire.
ex.ko: 아빠는 라이터로 캠프파이어에 불을 붙이셨다.

easy: A small green or black fruit with a hard seed. People eat it or make oil from it.

ex.en: I put an olive on each finger like a tiny hat.
ex.ko: 나는 손가락마다 올리브를 하나씩 끼워 작은 모자처럼 만들었다.

easy: A tree from warm places like Greece. Its small green or black fruit is used to make oil.

ex.en: An olive tree grew behind the old farmhouse.
ex.ko: 낡은 농가 뒤에는 올리브 나무 한 그루가 자라고 있었다.

easy: Feeling or showing very strong feelings about something.

ex.en: My brother is passionate about soccer and practices every day.
ex.ko: 내 동생은 축구에 열정적이어서 매일 연습한다.

easy: A machine that picks up radio or TV signals so you can hear or see them.

ex.en: Grandpa's old radio receiver crackled when he turned it on.
ex.ko: 할아버지의 오래된 라디오 수신기는 켜자 지직거렸다.

easy: The part of a phone you hold to your ear to listen.

ex.en: I picked up the receiver and heard Grandma's voice.
ex.ko: 나는 수화기를 들었고 할머니 목소리가 들렸다.

easy: Advice about what someone should do or choose.

ex.en: The librarian gave me a recommendation for a funny book.
ex.ko: 사서 선생님이 재미있는 책을 추천해 주셨다.

easy: A kind note or words saying that a person is good at something.

ex.en: My teacher wrote a recommendation for my science camp.
ex.ko: 선생님이 내 과학 캠프를 위해 추천서를 써 주셨다.

easy: When an angry crowd breaks things and fights in public.

ex.en: The police tried to stop the riot in the city.
ex.ko: 경찰은 도시의 폭동을 막으려 했다.

easy: A list of names, like the players on a team.

ex.en: My name is on the soccer team roster.
ex.ko: 내 이름은 축구팀 명단에 있다.

easy: A person whose job is to work in someone's home and help them.

ex.en: In the old story, a servant opened the castle door.
ex.ko: 옛이야기에서 하인이 성문을 열었다.

easy: A group of tools or machines put together for a job.

ex.en: Our science experiment needed a special setup with tubes and a lamp.
ex.ko: 우리 과학 실험에는 관과 램프가 있는 특별한 장치가 필요했다.

easy: The way things are arranged or organized.

ex.en: The setup of our new classroom lets us sit in groups.
ex.ko: 새 교실은 모둠으로 앉을 수 있게 배치되어 있다.

easy: A long, narrow opening where you put in something like a coin or a letter.

ex.en: I put a coin in the slot of my piggy bank.
ex.ko: 나는 돼지 저금통 투입구에 동전을 넣었다.

easy: A set time for something on a schedule.

ex.en: Our cartoon moved to a new time slot on Saturday.
ex.ko: 우리가 보는 만화는 토요일 새 시간대로 옮겼다.

easy: To break something into many pieces with a hard hit or fall.

ex.en: My ball smashed the neighbor's flowerpot.
ex.ko: 내 공이 이웃집 화분을 박살 냈다.

easy: In a way you did not expect.

ex.en: The new teacher was surprisingly funny.
ex.ko: 새로 오신 선생님은 뜻밖에 재미있으셨다.

easy: Used when something happens that makes everyone say wow.

ex.en: Surprisingly, our little team beat the best team.
ex.ko: 놀랍게도 우리 작은 팀이 최강 팀을 이겼다.

easy: Not trusting someone and thinking something may be wrong.

ex.en: The cat gave the new dog a suspicious look.
ex.ko: 고양이는 새로 온 강아지를 의심스러운 눈으로 쳐다보았다.

easy: Kind and gentle, caring about other people's feelings.

ex.en: Grandma has a tender heart and loves every animal.
ex.ko: 할머니는 마음이 다정해서 모든 동물을 사랑하신다.

easy: Painful when you touch it.

ex.en: My knee is still tender after I fell off my bike.
ex.ko: 자전거에서 넘어진 뒤로 무릎을 만지면 아직 아프다.

easy: Young and not yet grown up.

ex.en: He started playing the piano at a tender age.
ex.ko: 그는 어린 나이에 피아노를 치기 시작했다.

easy: A space with nothing in it, not even air.

ex.en: Space is almost a vacuum, so there is no air to breathe.
ex.ko: 우주는 거의 진공이라서 숨 쉴 공기가 없다.

easy: A place with no air or anything else inside.

ex.en: Astronauts work outside in the vacuum of space.
ex.ko: 우주 비행사는 우주의 진공 속으로 나가 일한다.

easy: Known and accepted by everyone as true.

ex.en: She is the acknowledged best singer in our school.
ex.ko: 그 애는 우리 학교에서 모두가 인정하는 최고의 가수다.

easy: Accepted by most people.

ex.en: He is an acknowledged expert on dinosaurs.
ex.ko: 그는 공룡에 관해 인정받는 전문가다.

easy: Waited for with hope and excitement.

ex.en: The most anticipated day of the year is my birthday.
ex.ko: 한 해 중 가장 기다려지는 날은 내 생일이다.

easy: To say yes and agree that something is okay.

ex.en: The principal approved our plan for a class garden.
ex.ko: 교장 선생님이 우리 학급 정원 계획을 승인하셨다.

easy: To think that something is good or right.

ex.en: Mom does not approve of eating candy before dinner.
ex.ko: 엄마는 저녁 전에 사탕 먹는 것을 좋게 생각하지 않으신다.

easy: Good for you or helpful.

ex.en: Eating fruit is beneficial to your body.
ex.ko: 과일을 먹는 것은 몸에 이롭다.

easy: Blood coming out of a cut or wound.

ex.en: Press a clean cloth on the cut to stop the bleeding.
ex.ko: 깨끗한 천으로 상처를 눌러 출혈을 멈추게 하렴.

easy: A woman who just got married.

ex.en: The bride wore a long white dress.
ex.ko: 신부는 긴 흰색 드레스를 입었다.

easy: A woman who is getting married at her wedding.

ex.en: The bride walked down the aisle holding flowers.
ex.ko: 신부는 꽃을 들고 통로를 걸어갔다.

easy: The main servant in a big house who helps with meals and guests.

ex.en: In the movie, the butler served tea to the guests.
ex.ko: 영화에서 집사가 손님들에게 차를 내왔다.

easy: A funny drawing in a newspaper or magazine.

ex.en: I cut out a funny cartoon from the Sunday paper.
ex.ko: 나는 일요일 신문에서 웃긴 만화를 오려 냈다.

easy: A movie or show made from many drawings that seem to move.

ex.en: We watch a cartoon about a talking dog every Saturday morning.
ex.ko: 우리는 토요일 아침마다 말하는 강아지 만화 영화를 본다.

easy: A baby bird, especially a baby chicken.

ex.en: The little chick followed the hen around the yard.
ex.ko: 병아리가 마당에서 암탉을 졸졸 따라다녔다.

easy: Alike enough that you can look at them side by side.

ex.en: The two bikes are comparable in speed.
ex.ko: 그 두 자전거는 속도가 비슷해서 비교할 만하다.

easy: More proof that something you thought is true.

ex.en: The dinosaur bones gave confirmation that giant animals lived here.
ex.ko: 공룡 뼈는 이곳에 거대한 동물이 살았다는 것을 확증해 주었다.

easy: News or words that say something is true or settled.

ex.en: We got a confirmation email for our class trip.
ex.ko: 우리는 현장 학습 확인 이메일을 받았다.

easy: A panel with screens and buttons used to control a machine or computer.

ex.en: The engineer pressed a button on the console.
ex.ko: 기술자가 제어반의 버튼을 눌렀다.

easy: A person or company that is hired to build things.

ex.en: A contractor came to build a new room on our house.
ex.ko: 건설업자가 우리 집에 새 방을 지으러 왔다.

easy: Helping to cause something to happen.

ex.en: Rain was a contributing reason the game was canceled.
ex.ko: 비가 경기가 취소된 한 가지 원인이었다.

easy: The distance straight across a circle through its middle.

ex.en: The diameter of the pizza is twelve inches.
ex.ko: 그 피자의 지름은 12인치다.

easy: A straight line across a circle that goes through its middle.

ex.en: Use a ruler to measure the diameter of the coin.
ex.ko: 자로 동전의 지름을 재 보렴.

easy: To throw something away.

ex.en: Please do not dump trash in the river.
ex.ko: 강에 쓰레기를 버리지 마세요.

easy: Two things or two people that go together.

ex.en: A duo of ducks swam across the pond.
ex.ko: 오리 한 쌍이 연못을 가로질러 헤엄쳤다.

easy: Two people who sing or play music together.

ex.en: The brother and sister duo sang at the school show.
ex.ko: 남매 듀오가 학교 발표회에서 노래했다.

easy: A huge gray animal with big ears and a long nose called a trunk.

ex.en: The elephant sprayed water on its back with its trunk.
ex.ko: 코끼리는 코로 자기 등에 물을 뿌렸다.

easy: Made better, bigger, or stronger.

ex.en: The enhanced photo looked brighter and clearer.
ex.ko: 보정한 사진은 더 밝고 선명해 보였다.

easy: Cloth made by weaving or knitting thread together.

ex.en: Mom picked blue fabric to sew my costume.
ex.ko: 엄마는 내 의상을 만들려고 파란 천을 고르셨다.

easy: Very, very good.

ex.en: We had a fabulous day at the beach.
ex.ko: 우리는 해변에서 정말 멋진 하루를 보냈다.

easy: Told about in old stories but not real.

ex.en: Dragons are fabulous creatures from old stories.
ex.ko: 용은 옛이야기에 나오는 전설 속의 동물이다.

easy: A tiny magical creature in stories, often with wings.

ex.en: The fairy waved her wand and the pumpkin became a coach.
ex.ko: 요정이 지팡이를 흔들자 호박이 마차로 변했다.

easy: A line or bend made when you fold paper or cloth.

ex.en: Press the fold of the paper to make a paper airplane.
ex.ko: 종이비행기를 만들려면 접힌 부분을 꾹 눌러라.

easy: Slowly, with only a little change.

ex.en: The hill slopes gently down to the lake.
ex.ko: 언덕은 호수 쪽으로 완만하게 기울어 있다.

easy: In a soft and kind way.

ex.en: Please pet the baby rabbit gently.
ex.ko: 아기 토끼를 부드럽게 쓰다듬어 주렴.

easy: With very little force or weight.

ex.en: I gently placed the egg in the basket.
ex.ko: 나는 달걀을 바구니에 살살 놓았다.

easy: Famous and honored for doing great things.

ex.en: The team had a glorious win in the final game.
ex.ko: 그 팀은 결승전에서 영광스러운 승리를 거두었다.

easy: Very beautiful and wonderful to see.

ex.en: We had a glorious sunny morning for our picnic.
ex.ko: 우리는 눈부시게 화창한 아침에 소풍을 갔다.

easy: A very deep sadness, like when someone you love dies.

ex.en: Grief filled the house when our old dog died.
ex.ko: 우리 늙은 개가 죽자 집 안이 슬픔으로 가득했다.

easy: Over a long time in the past.

ex.en: Historically, people used horses to travel long distances.
ex.ko: 역사적으로 사람들은 먼 거리를 갈 때 말을 이용했다.

easy: In a way that has to do with history.

ex.en: The old bridge is historically important to our town.
ex.ko: 그 오래된 다리는 우리 마을에서 역사적으로 중요하다.

easy: The middle part of a wheel that the rod passes through.

ex.en: The spokes of my bike wheel connect to the hub.
ex.ko: 내 자전거 바퀴의 살은 바퀴통에 연결되어 있다.

easy: The busy middle place where many things come together.

ex.en: The kitchen is the hub of our home.
ex.ko: 부엌은 우리 집의 중심이다.

easy: Sure to happen, and you cannot stop it.

ex.en: Rain was inevitable, so we packed umbrellas.
ex.ko: 비가 오는 건 피할 수 없어서 우리는 우산을 챙겼다.

easy: Always happening, just as you expect.

ex.en: The inevitable winter cold made us wear hats.
ex.ko: 겨울이면 어김없이 찾아오는 추위에 우리는 모자를 썼다.

easy: A unit for how heavy things are. It equals 1,000 grams.

ex.en: My puppy weighs five kg.
ex.ko: 우리 강아지는 몸무게가 5킬로그램이다.

easy: How things are placed on a page or in a space.

ex.en: I drew the layout of my dream bedroom.
ex.ko: 나는 내가 꿈꾸는 침실의 배치도를 그렸다.

easy: Having a row of things along both sides.

ex.en: We walked down a street lined with tall trees.
ex.ko: 우리는 키 큰 나무가 줄지어 선 거리를 걸었다.

easy: Having lines or wrinkles on it.

ex.en: Grandpa's lined face smiled when he saw us.
ex.ko: 할아버지의 주름진 얼굴이 우리를 보고 웃었다.

easy: Having soft cloth or fur on the inside.

ex.en: My winter coat is lined with soft fur.
ex.ko: 내 겨울 코트는 안쪽에 부드러운 털이 대어져 있다.

easy: A small house in the woods or mountains where people stay for a short time.

ex.en: We stayed at a ski lodge in the mountains.
ex.ko: 우리는 산속 스키 산장에서 묵었다.

easy: A good quality that makes someone or something worth praise.

ex.en: Her drawing has real merit.
ex.ko: 그 애의 그림에는 정말 훌륭한 점이 있다.

easy: Very, very small.

ex.en: A micro robot can fit on your fingertip.
ex.ko: 초소형 로봇은 손끝에 올라갈 수 있다.

easy: Thinking about one thing all the time.

ex.en: My brother is obsessed with his video game and talks about it all day.
ex.ko: 내 동생은 비디오 게임에 푹 빠져서 하루 종일 그 얘기만 한다.

easy: Controlled by a strong feeling or idea.

ex.en: She was obsessed with winning the spelling bee.
ex.ko: 그 애는 철자 맞히기 대회에서 이기는 데 사로잡혀 있었다.

easy: So strong that you cannot stop it.

ex.en: I felt an overwhelming urge to laugh in class.
ex.ko: 나는 수업 시간에 웃음을 참을 수 없을 만큼 강한 충동을 느꼈다.

easy: Very strong and always on your mind.

ex.en: Her overwhelming joy made her jump up and down.
ex.ko: 그 애는 기쁨이 넘쳐서 폴짝폴짝 뛰었다.

easy: Light in color, with a lot of white mixed in.

ex.en: She painted the wall a pale pink.
ex.ko: 그 애는 벽을 연한 분홍색으로 칠했다.

easy: Weak and dim, not bright.

ex.en: The pale light of the moon shone on the lake.
ex.ko: 희미한 달빛이 호수 위를 비추었다.

easy: For a very long time or forever.

ex.en: The paint stained my shirt permanently.
ex.ko: 페인트가 내 셔츠에 영원히 얼룩을 남겼다.

easy: To put a harmful substance into something.

ex.en: In the story, the witch poisoned the apple.
ex.ko: 이야기 속에서 마녀가 사과에 독을 넣었다.

easy: Having to do with one big region of a country that has its own leaders.

ex.en: Each Canadian province has its own provincial government.
ex.ko: 캐나다의 각 주는 자체 지방 정부를 가지고 있다.

easy: Not together; apart from the others.

ex.en: Please wash the red shirts separately from the white ones.
ex.ko: 빨간 셔츠는 흰 셔츠와 따로 빨아 주세요.

easy: Moving something up and down or back and forth very fast.

ex.en: Shaking the snow globe made the snow swirl.
ex.ko: 스노볼을 흔들자 눈이 빙글빙글 날렸다.

easy: Moving back and forth in small, quick moves, like when you are cold or scared.

ex.en: The shaking of my hands stopped when I felt calm.
ex.ko: 마음이 진정되자 내 손의 떨림이 멈췄다.

easy: Small and hard to notice.

ex.en: There was a subtle change in the sky's color before the storm.
ex.ko: 폭풍이 오기 전에 하늘 색이 미묘하게 변했다.

easy: Money you pay to drive on a certain road or bridge.

ex.en: Dad paid the toll before we crossed the bridge.
ex.ko: 아빠는 다리를 건너기 전에 통행료를 내셨다.

easy: One of the hard white parts in your mouth for biting and chewing.

ex.en: I lost my first tooth while eating an apple.
ex.ko: 나는 사과를 먹다가 첫 번째 이가 빠졌다.

easy: One of the pointy parts in a row, like on a comb or a saw.

ex.en: One tooth of my comb broke off.
ex.ko: 내 빗의 빗살 하나가 부러졌다.

easy: Ripped, with rough, uneven edges.

ex.en: I patched my torn jeans with a star.
ex.ko: 나는 찢어진 청바지에 별 모양 천을 덧댔다.

easy: Not able to decide because you want two different things.

ex.en: I was torn between playing soccer and going to the movies.
ex.ko: 나는 축구를 할지 영화를 보러 갈지 마음이 갈렸다.

easy: Very sad, often because of death or something terrible.

ex.en: The movie had a tragic ending, and everyone cried.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 비극적인 결말이라 모두가 울었다.

easy: A person who teaches people or animals to do something.

ex.en: The dog trainer taught Max to sit and roll over.
ex.ko: 개 훈련사가 맥스에게 앉기와 구르기를 가르쳤다.

easy: Changed so much that it looks completely different.

ex.en: The transformed room looked like a jungle for the party.
ex.ko: 파티를 위해 완전히 바뀐 방은 정글처럼 보였다.

easy: On the bottom side of something.

ex.en: Gum was stuck underneath my desk.
ex.ko: 껌이 내 책상 아래쪽에 붙어 있었다.

easy: Under something, right below it.

ex.en: I lifted the rug and found a coin underneath.
ex.ko: 나는 깔개를 들춰 보고 그 밑에서 동전을 찾았다.

easy: Caused by a virus, a tiny germ that makes you sick.

ex.en: I stayed home with a viral cold.
ex.ko: 나는 바이러스성 감기에 걸려 집에 있었다.

easy: A big building where lots of goods are kept until they are sold.

ex.en: Boxes of toys are stored in the warehouse.
ex.ko: 장난감 상자들이 창고에 보관되어 있다.

easy: To keep things in a big storage building.

ex.en: The company warehouses toys before the holidays.
ex.ko: 그 회사는 명절 전에 장난감을 창고에 보관한다.

easy: A woman whose husband has died.

ex.en: The widow lived next door and baked us cookies.
ex.ko: 옆집에 사는 미망인 할머니가 우리에게 쿠키를 구워 주셨다.

easy: To change something a little so it is right.

ex.en: I adjusted the clock to the right time.
ex.ko: 나는 시계를 정확한 시각에 맞췄다.

easy: To change yourself so you feel okay in a new place.

ex.en: It took me a week to adjust to my new school.
ex.ko: 새 학교에 적응하는 데 일주일이 걸렸다.

easy: A person who runs or manages a school, office, or business.

ex.en: The school administrator planned the new lunch schedule.
ex.ko: 학교 행정 담당자가 새 점심시간표를 짰다.

easy: United together as a team or group.

ex.en: The allied countries agreed to help one another.
ex.ko: 동맹을 맺은 나라들은 서로 돕기로 약속했다.

easy: Joined together by a promise to help each other.

ex.en: The two allied countries signed a promise to help each other.
ex.ko: 동맹을 맺은 두 나라는 서로 돕겠다는 약속에 서명했다.

easy: Counting everything together.

ex.en: We have twelve books altogether.
ex.ko: 우리는 책이 모두 합쳐 열두 권 있다.

easy: Thinking about everything, not the small parts.

ex.en: Altogether, it was a great school year.
ex.ko: 전체적으로 멋진 한 해였다.

easy: Made to look like it moves and is alive, like in a cartoon.

ex.en: My favorite animated movie is about a talking fish.
ex.ko: 내가 제일 좋아하는 애니메이션 영화는 말하는 물고기 이야기다.

easy: To look carefully and decide how good or how big something is.

ex.en: The teacher will assess our science projects on Friday.
ex.ko: 선생님은 금요일에 우리 과학 프로젝트를 평가하실 것이다.

easy: An idea you accept as true so you can figure out something else.

ex.en: On the assumption that it will rain, we packed umbrellas.
ex.ko: 비가 올 것이라고 가정하고 우리는 우산을 챙겼다.

easy: Something you believe is true without checking.

ex.en: I made the assumption that the store was open, but it was closed.
ex.ko: 나는 가게가 열었으리라 추측했는데 문이 닫혀 있었다.

easy: Sure of yourself and not shy.

ex.en: The assured pitcher threw the ball with a smile.
ex.ko: 자신감 있는 투수가 미소를 지으며 공을 던졌다.

easy: Sure to happen or safe.

ex.en: Our win was assured after the last goal.
ex.ko: 마지막 골이 들어가자 우리의 승리는 확실해졌다.

easy: A container made of woven strips, usually with handles.

ex.en: We picked apples and filled the basket.
ex.ko: 우리는 사과를 따서 바구니를 가득 채웠다.

easy: All the things that fit in one container with handles.

ex.en: I ate a whole basket of strawberries.
ex.ko: 나는 딸기 한 바구니를 다 먹었다.

easy: The round metal ring with a net that players shoot the ball into.

ex.en: He threw the ball and it went right into the basket.
ex.ko: 그가 공을 던지자 공이 곧바로 골대 안으로 들어갔다.

easy: The hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.

ex.en: Grandpa's long white beard tickles when he hugs me.
ex.ko: 할아버지의 긴 흰 수염은 나를 안으실 때 간지럽다.

easy: A big, soft cover that keeps you warm in bed.

ex.en: I pulled the blanket up to my chin.
ex.ko: 나는 담요를 턱까지 끌어 올렸다.
